meal.title: Define a method in a class
meal.objective: Create a function inside a class that operates on its instances

voice.script: How can a class actually do something? How do I make a student greet? A method is just a function written inside a class definition, and it always receives the instance as its first parameter, usually named self. That lets the method read or change the instance’s attributes. In the code we define the method, use self.name inside the message, create a Student object, and call greet. Running it prints the greeting, showing the method works on that specific instance. Remember: methods let objects behave, not just hold data. Now try writing a method that returns the student’s email address.
